values.note: Reserve by phone or email with the town office and pay in full (e-transfer) to confirm; check in at the Town Office, 209 Main Street, weekdays during office hours, for a permit before going to the site. A cancellation 4 or more days out costs C$25.

booking.source: https://www.gravelbourg.ca/visitors/campgrounds_parks.html ('Please call 306-648-3301 to check availability and make a reservation'; 'All vehicles must stop at the Town Office (Court House) at 209 Main Street for their camping permit ... The Town Office is open Monday-Friday from 8:00 am - 12:00 pm and 1:00 pm - 5:00 pm'); https://www.gravelbourg.ca/mrws/filedriver/Campground/Campground%20Rules.pdf ('RESERVATIONS WILL NOT BE CONFIRMED WITHOUT PAYMENT'; 'cancelled 4 or more calendar days prior to arrival ... a Campsite Cancellation Fee of $25.00'), read 2026-11-18

values.note: Full service C$30 a night or C$180 a week; non-serviced C$20.

fees.source: https://www.gravelbourg.ca/visitors/campgrounds_parks.html ('Full Service : $30 / Night or $180 / week; Non-Serviced Sites : $20 / Night'), read 2026-11-18

note: Small town campground in a fenced lot south of the Palestre rink off 4th Avenue East, a short walk from Gravelbourg's co-cathedral and museum. No washrooms; no open fires. --Claude
summary: Keep (town campground). 8 full-service sites, C$30 (C$20 non-serviced), May 1 - Sep 30, phone/email reservation with check-in at the Town Office (weekday hours). No public washrooms. Pin OK. All stored values confirmed; facilities showers/flush false added.
flags: CHECK-IN: every camper must pick up a permit at the Town Office (Mon-Fri, 8-12 and 1-5) before going to the site - weekend or evening arrivals need to arrange it ahead (rules give an after-hours number only after check-in).
FACILITIES: 'There is no public washroom facilities' (rules PDF) - showers/flush_toilets false.
PIN: stored 49.87540,-106.54950 is ~40 m west of the fenced campground lot (49.8750,-106.5491; RVs and pedestals visible on Esri z18). Keep.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - in town, no water near.
WEBSITE: stored https://gravelbourg.ca/visitors/campgrounds_parks.html works; the canonical is https://www.gravelbourg.ca/visitors/campgrounds_parks.html (either).
LONG-STAY: none - all 8 sites nightly/weekly; Google Maps 'Gravelbourg RV Campground' 4.5 (2 reviews).

LEAD: Shamrock Regional Park (RM of Shamrock, ~20 min NE of Gravelbourg on the Wood River; www.shamrockregionalpark.ca, 306-648-3594) is not in campgrounds.json and appears nowhere under audit/ - not vetted. (Thomson Lake RP is 9277.)
